title: O03-2 comprehensive driver pacing fix: independent read-only review

scope.purpose: Confirm action pacing fixes synchronous test-driver starvation without removing business checks, and statically inspect fresh-build/run guards.

changes: After the hospital navigation assertion, add a three-line explanation of synchronous QWidget QTest dispatch and QTest::qWait(10).
After the account navigation assertion, add QTest::qWait(10).
diff.other_measurement_changes: None in the reviewed formal C++ test. Probe calculation, signal timing boundary, raw heartbeat array, result fields and thresholds are unchanged.
diff.whole_file_proof: Replacing the single original two-navigation-statement block with those same statements plus the exact five added lines reconstructs the entire current file after LF/CRLF normalization.

coverage_preserved.assessment: Loop remains iteration<50 with hospital+account assertions each iteration; all page/store identity, child counts, initialization counts and no-dirty assertions remain. repeat_page_transitions stays100.
Option values, unusual role filters, administrator invalid update index, Guest refusal, forged role refusal, transaction identity/role recheck and current-session invalidation remain text-identical.
Six-field cleanup and hidden-page permissions tests remain text-identical. No password verification, cleanup or evidence-redaction helper changed.

coverage_preserved.area: Original running rule and automatic logout
coverage_preserved.assessment: Running-state current-user deletion refusal, equality-based update refusal, changed-role update commit/logout, real double-click target restoration, current-account delete logout and exact one-logout assertions remain.
Cancel retains draft/identity; accept restores persisted hospital snapshot without draft writes; repeat logout remains a no-op. All checks are unchanged.

coverage_preserved.area: Account lock, navigation/close rejection and recovery
coverage_preserved.assessment: BEGIN IMMEDIATE setup, real busy navigation/logout/close attempts, no partial commit, at least5 heartbeat callbacks, rejection count, unlock and successful retry remain text-identical.
Window close, worker shutdown, independent writer/read PIDs, public snapshot equivalence, formal application exit test and exit-code checks remain text-identical.

pacing_interpretation.frequency: Two added source calls execute per iteration;50 iterations therefore add100 opportunities for queued events and nominal1000ms of event-loop time.
pacing_interpretation.reason: The old helper can complete synchronously once navigationChanged satisfies its predicate; adding event-loop intervals between actions prevents a100-action GUI-thread test burst from deferring heartbeat/paint dispatch until its end.
pacing_interpretation.scope: This is test scheduling correction. It does not change product UI, retained animations, account/hospital business rules or storage code.
pacing_interpretation.comparison_limit: A corrected heartbeat maximum is a separate paced-workload result. Preserve the old unpaced1556.009424ms observation; do not describe shorter heartbeat gaps as a product speed optimization or delete the old data.
pacing_interpretation.completion_vs_responsiveness: QTest::qWait dispatches events; its deliberate wall-clock interval is not added to click-to-navigationChanged signal latency. Total experiment duration and GUI inter-delivery gaps remain different metrics.

pipeline_review.observed_increment: Owner added a constrained optional run_label to retain independent retries/logs; fresh-build, exact-text check and binary SHA guard remain. The later SHA is the reviewed pipeline snapshot.

checks.finding: Build refuses an existing corrected target and copies only the recorded final_03 public source snapshot, checking each source SHA before copy.
Checks exactly one original navigation block and requires old.replace(before,after)==current before writing the changed test into its separate snapshot.
Test.pro must match archived O03-2 SHA; it is copied unchanged.

qmake and make use subprocess.run(check=True); failure raises before build_metadata.json is written. Successful metadata binds base source manifest, corrected test, unchanged pro and freshly produced binary SHA.

Run requires success metadata and matching binary SHA, refuses existing data and existing per-slot log, retains each result/exit code and stops on the first failing test. There is no fallback to an earlier binary.

Separate diagnosis runner also verifies any reused successful frozen target, removes its known executable before a new build, uses errexit+pipefail, and only records build metadata after qmake/make completion; run validates manifest/binary fingerprints.
Formal account-test path builds before exec under errexit and uses qmake&&make in build; qmake/make failure returns before test exec. No explicit stale-binary fallback exists in this path.

conclusion.remaining: Owner must complete/review the corrected full-regression runtime results under these exact test and pipeline hashes. This independent review does not report a fresh runtime pass.
